summary: P9 meets its outcome: the image builds strict with check_site.py and nginx -t, serves / and /docs/ on port 80 with relative redirects, and pins images.pipelines into PipelinesDeploy as P8's chart expects. The root Jenkinsfile follows the guide and passes the linter inside kc project lint, and IaC/JenkinsPipelineUtils is live with the push trigger and its config.xml saved. No findings.
